title: Missouri Parenting Plan Modification — Preparation Packet
description: Prepares a Missouri parent to request a parenting-plan modification under RSMo 452.410 by organizing relevant facts, gathering required documentation, and producing a preparation packet for an attorney or self-representation. **Educational preparation support, not legal advice. Statutory citations may change.**

jurisdictionTags.scopeNote: Missouri-specific. Other states have different modification standards.

steps.title: Confirm Missouri jurisdiction
steps.content: This playbook is written for Missouri (US-MO). Confirm that Missouri is the state where the current parenting plan was issued or where the child has primary residence. If not, stop and find a jurisdiction-specific playbook.

steps.title: Current order details
steps.content: Provide information about the current parenting plan.

expectedInputs.name: countyCourt
expectedInputs.label: Missouri county where order was entered

expectedInputs.name: lastModificationDate
expectedInputs.label: Date of most recent modification (if any)

steps.title: Change in circumstances
steps.content: Missouri requires a substantial and continuing change in circumstances since the current order. Describe what has changed.

expectedInputs.name: impactOnChild
expectedInputs.label: How does this affect the child's best interests?

steps.title: Evidence inventory
steps.content: List the documents, messages, records, and witnesses that support the requested modification.

steps.title: Proposed modification
steps.content: State specifically what modification you are requesting. Vague requests ('more time') are weaker than specific ones ('alternating weeks plus Wednesday overnights').

expectedInputs.name: rationale
expectedInputs.label: How does this serve the child's best interests?

steps.title: Best-interests analysis
steps.content: The assistant will produce a structured analysis mapped to Missouri's statutory best-interests factors. Review carefully and edit before use.

steps.title: Preparation packet
steps.content: Produce a Word document containing: case summary, change-in-circumstances narrative, best-interests analysis, evidence inventory, proposed modification with rationale, and questions for an attorney consultation.

artifactTemplates.name: Missouri Parenting Plan Modification Preparation Packet

reviewStatus.reviewNotes: Statutory citations verified against current RSMo 452.410. Annual re-review scheduled.

additionalDisclosures: Missouri statutes can change. Always verify RSMo 452.410 current text before filing.
Unauthorized practice of law rules prohibit this platform from advising on your specific case. Consult a licensed Missouri attorney.

safetyNotes: If there is an active safety concern for you or your child, consult a licensed attorney and consider a domestic violence advocate before using this playbook. Filing a modification can sometimes escalate conflict.
